name: Saimoku Jutsu Gaiden AVG
source:
Saimokujutsu: the way of turning statements into actions

After helping a bloodied man who lay in the street, a typical timid student is awarded the power of "saimoku". With a gaze and a word he can entrance people. The boring life of Yuuta Uchida is changed forever.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ144206.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
催目术，将话语化为行动的能力。

一名普通而胆怯的学生，救下了倒在街上、浑身是血的男人，作为回报，获得了“催目”的力量。只凭目光与一句话，他便能让人陷入恍惚。Yuuta Uchida乏味的生活，就此永远改变。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ144206.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
